messages.subject: ezPredict() to_predict specification
parts:
Dear group,

I'm having difficulty with the to_predict specification in
ezPredict(). The code below leads to the error message:
"Error in match(x, table, nomatch = 0L) : object 'data_vars' not
found"

Thanks in advance for any suggestions on how to resolve this.
Ray


#Read in the ANT data (see ?ANT).
data(ANT)
head(ANT)

#fit a mixed effects model to the error rate data
er_fit = lmer(
formula = error ~ cue*flank*group + (1|subnum)
, family = binomial
, data = ANT
)

#obtain the predictions from the model
newdat <- expand.grid(
cue=c("None", "Center", "Double", "Spatial")
, flank=c("Neutral", "Congruent", "Incongruent")
, group=c("Control", "Treatment")
)

er_preds = ezPredict(
fit = er_fit
, to_predict = newdat
)

huh, I'm surprised that this bug in v3.0-0 didn't crop up until now.
Thanks for the heads up. The bug was subsequently fixed (at some
point) but I added the bug to the issues list
(https://github.com/mike-lawrence/ez/issues/22) in case anyone else
comes across it.

Mike
